decision: Do not ship a quote-only change. The original entire packet remains rejected, but its food0/1 erase decisions individually pass the existing decoder and plan validator. Inherited evidence alone would not protect the explicit keep boundary.

ranked_hypotheses.prediction: The original card resolves to two same-tenant active parents and three uniquely located source quotes; missing/cyclic/erased/ambiguous/unlinked evidence rejects.
ranked_hypotheses.result: Supported by a read-only prototype and 13 passing diagnostics. No runtime decoder or plan schema was changed.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: The aggregate witness failure currently hides an independent authorization hole in erasure expansion.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Original food0 and food1 erase decisions will pass decodeErasure plus validateErasurePlan if checked independently.
ranked_hypotheses.result: Confirmed: both required safety tests are red on unchanged50cc. The full original four-decision packet is still rejected.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: A property/source-only guard cannot both preserve independent same-literal facts and execute all renamed/implicitly dependent erasures.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Blanket cross-slot rejection will also reject existing same-chunk renamed-property erasure cases; blanket source propagation will delete independent neighboring records.
ranked_hypotheses.result: Supported by the existing cross-scope/source-context contracts (15 passing baseline tests). Such a rule may only fail the transaction conservatively, never force retain or claim successful completion.

source_provenance.visibility_correction: searchable=false is normal raw-retrieval suppression after successful fact extraction (storage.ts:428,488), not proof of erasure. snapshot.erasureSources includes stored messages (storage.ts:125). The prototype checks intact source content and conservatively rejects redacted source records instead of using searchable as an evidence gate.

prototype_bounds.source_tables: Only server-read same-tenant snapshot facts/messages; model-supplied dependency/source tables are never trusted.
prototype_bounds.identity: Fingerprint binds tenant, card, parent propositions/states and original source bytes.

food_boundary_findings.finding: The direct quote says food scene there, while the structured fact supplies Portland from neighboring residence context. A keep decision cannot borrow a value_context that is removed with the residence claim. The real retained-value-context guard still rejects that counterfactual.
Its own exact food-memory quote contains Portland; a restaurant visit does not establish residence. The recorded erase reason conflates them despite the full original keep clause being present.
effect=uncertain is independently a semantic refusal. Even a hypothetical real parent quote must not convert uncertain into erase or retain.

ordered_implementation_plan.change: Define a read-only inherited-evidence protocol for source-less derived facts. Resolve explicit depends_on from the tenant snapshot, preserve parent/source identity, and expose evidence tables without mutating source_quotes or inventing a new fact.
ordered_implementation_plan.acceptance: All dependency branches must have valid supported evidence; absent, stale, cyclic, ambiguous or redacted evidence remains a refusal. Bind witness structure and source bytes into prepare/commit fingerprints. Original generated aggregate-content quotes remain invalid.

ordered_implementation_plan.change: Before accepting any cross-property erasure expansion, independently verify the proposed final erased/retained propositions against the complete original instruction, including explicit keep exceptions. Treat the scope classifier’s erase decision as a proposal, not an authorization certificate.
ordered_implementation_plan.acceptance: Current recorded food0/1 erase packets must be rejected independently of the aggregate candidate. Missing or negative semantic certificates reject the whole transaction; never automatically relabel them retain. Do not create substitute deletion authority from overlapping words, same-source IDs, or property labels.

ordered_implementation_plan.change: Validate inherited witnesses and retention contexts again against the final union of source cuts and erased dependency IDs.
ordered_implementation_plan.acceptance: A retained card cannot cite an erased parent or cut value/context. Retiring a contaminated derived representation must preserve independently supported raw clauses and member facts. Same-fact renamed-property echoes must not silently survive; genuine ambiguity rejects.

ordered_implementation_plan.change: Only after the two food safety tests are green together with the inherited-evidence tests, consider a new separately authorized live validation.
ordered_implementation_plan.acceptance: Keep the original uncertain verdict and original wrong food erase outputs immutable and rejected. A synthetic revised proposal or local witness transport success is not a new semantic verdict, successful add, or score change.

why_no_production_commit: The parent-witness transport prototype can be validated locally, but no minimal deterministic rule was shown to honor both natural-language keep exceptions and renamed/implicit dependency erasures. Shipping only that transport change would remove the current aggregate blocker while leaving food0/1 authorization unprotected. The explicit safety requirements therefore remain red and no deployable change was committed.

required_food_guard_red.expected: The two isolated original food erases should be rejected but are accepted; full original packet still rejects.
